" ) def render_blog_post(author_id: str, post_heading: str, content: str, labels: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate a secure, XSS‑protected HTML representation of a blog post. Parameters ---------- author_id : str Identifier of the user who created the post. post_heading : str Heading/title of the post. content : str Main body/content of the post. labels : list[str] List of tags/labels associated with the post. Returns ------- str Escaped HTML string ready to be served in a web page. Notes ----- All user‑supplied data is escaped using html.escape to neutralize potentially malicious input. The tags are individually wrapped in a element with the class 'tag' to avoid accidental injection of HTML. """ # Escape all user-provided strings safe_author_id = html.escape(author_id, quote=True) safe_heading = html.escape(post_heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=False) # content may contain line breaks # Render each label safely rendered_labels = [] for label in labels: safe_label = html.escape(label, quote=True) rendered_labels.append(f" {safe_label}") labels_block = "\n".join(rendered_labels) # Combine everything using the predefined format return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_id=safe_author_id, post_heading=safe_heading, content=safe_content, labels=labels_block )
